title: NIST WebBook: Trichloromethane is CHCl3, molecular weight 119.378 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Trichloromethane as CHCl3, molecular weight 119.378 amu, CAS 67-66-3.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Trichloromethane, CAS Registry Number 67-66-3, lists molecular formula CHCl3 and molecular weight 119.378 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 117.9143831 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/CHCl3/c2-1(3)4/h1H. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
